scope: FFPE tissues were deparaffinized by shaking in 500 µL Xylene for 5 min, followed by removal of the solvent and air-dry the residual solvent. Tissues were resuspended in 200 µL lysis buffer (300 mM TRIS/HCl, 2% SDS, pH 8.0), shock-frozen in liquid nitrogen and immediately heated for 25 min at 99 °C and 350 rounds per minute (rpm).
Supernatants were combined and protein concentration was determined using the Pierce 660 nm Protein Assay (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Idstein, Germany).
20 µg total protein were reduced by adding 10 µL 300 mM DTT
